correctness.rationale: For the frozen claim the integral radius-two homotopy result and the low-stage losses check out. The assertion of a full ordinary integral barcode as written is not justified: equal later complexes and vanishing scale maps do not imply free integral homology in every later stage. Adams–Virk Proposition 3.3 is about maps, not the groups; the checked newer source only establishes certain top-degree freeness results. This is not evidence of torsion in a specific cube. The repaired result specifies the full barcode comparison over every field and the exact integral comparison as a splitting off of the free early intervals with a common, unclassified integral remainder. Corrected affected files are in /workspace/repairs/3/. For the final theorem: in Hamming distance at least two, forward and reverse flip orders give shortest paths with disjoint interiors, so one avoids the deleted edge. Its endpoints now have distance exactly three. At radius two the only faces removed contain that edge. The link is two (n−2)-simplices joined by n−1 matching edges, with integral H₁ basis given by the rung difference squares. Relative simplicial chains identify with augmented link chains shifted by two. For each coordinate three-cube on {1,2,i}, the oriented cross-polytope boundary restricts relatively to the matching square with coefficients ±1, so the map onto the relative group is integral and onto. With the intact wedge theorem, the pair sequence gives a single free reduced group of rank cₙ−(n−2). The intersection in the star cover is the suspension of a connected link, and both the faulty graph and the scale-two complex are connected. Van Kampen gives simple connectivity, then Hurewicz and homology Whitehead realize the claimed sphere wedge, including the point when n=3. At one the connected triangle-free graph loses exactly one cycle rank. At three and above the complexes and inclusions are identical. The maps out of the earlier positive-degree intervals vanish: H₁ is zero at two, and the degree-three map at three factors through the nullhomotopic intact transition. Thus the early intervals split over Z without any assumption on the tail and give the asserted field barcode difference. The independent finite check found exactly the exceptional pair {0,1}, ranks 1→0, 9→7, 49→46, 209→205 over F₂, and all indicated link-square images for n=3–6. It is not a proof about integral torsion or higher scales.
residual_risks: No higher-scale integral freeness, arbitrary fault pattern or weighted edge result is claimed. The shared high-scale module is not classified.
